criteria: Distinguishes elements, compounds and mixtures and chooses a suitable separation method

Writes electronic structures and calculates relative atomic mass from isotope data
S01_Atoms_Elements_and_the_Atomic_Model.pass_threshold: Foundation: correct on element, compound and mixture definitions, particle charges and electron shells (grade 4-5). Higher: also calculates relative atomic mass from isotope abundance and explains model changes with evidence.

criteria: Explains how the periodic table is arranged and how it developed, including Mendeleev's predictions

Explains the effect of particle size on surface area to volume ratio and properties

criteria: Two complete, timed 1 hour 45 minute, 100-mark papers at the learner's tier (Paper 1: topics 4.1-4.5; Paper 2: topics 4.6-4.10)
At least one required-practical-based question answered correctly in each paper
Performance holds up across topics under mixed order, including Chemistry-only depth content
Calculations show working and units, and extended answers use precise scientific vocabulary
exam_rubric.pass_threshold: Foundation tier: performance consistent with grade 4-5 across full papers. Higher tier: performance consistent with grade 6-7. AQA sets exact grade boundaries per series rather than a fixed mark table.
